response.justification: While Bogdan is an exceptionally talented full-stack software engineer with 16+ years of experience and strong architectural thinking, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role. His professional C++ experience is minimal (~6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015) with no recent usage, and his career has been entirely focused on web, mobile, and backend development rather than industrial automation, embedded systems, or IoT. The role specifically requires deep C++ expertise, familiarity with industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, etc.), IEC 62443 compliance, and systems-level thinking—none of which are evident in his profile.
strengths: Over 16 years of experience exceeding requirements, with proven progression to Staff engineer level
Strong software architecture and event-driven systems expertise demonstrated in large-scale microservices platforms
Proven mentoring capability with evidence of technical workshops, courses, and developer training initiatives
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015, none recent)
Career exclusively in web/full-stack development with no industrial automation or embedded systems background
No expertise in industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, DNP 3.0, OPC UA) or IEC 62443 security standards

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and embedded systems domain
Event-driven architecture and large-scale systems design
